svg.text: One Organization, three accounts, one set of rules nobody inside can override. Region us-east-1.
org ID: o-io418t8hv2 - All features mode
SCPs do not apply here - keep this account empty of workloads
deny stopping or deleting CloudTrail trails
ceilings only - grant nothing, apply to every
principal in the account, admins and root included
the three SCPs above apply to everything inside this OU
admin tries EC2 in us-west-1 -> denied by SCP
admin tries to stop the throwaway trail -> denied by SCP
even full AdministratorAccess cannot override this
developer can create a role only with the boundary attached
boundary caps effective permissions to S3 read-only,
even after attaching AmazonEC2FullAccess to that role
developer in Dev builds freely (S3, roles, etc.)
same developer in Prod: read only, write denied
implicit deny - nothing in Prod ever granted write
a role here was trusted to an account outside the org
Access Analyzer raised it as Active,
fixing the trust to an in-org account resolved it
The management account decides the rules once. The Workloads OU enforces them everywhere underneath it.
A developer, an admin and an auditor share the same accounts and get three different outcomes, decided entirely by group membership.
